title: Caramelized Honey Tacos
description: A sweet and savory Mexican dish featuring caramelized honey, crispy oozing cheese, and a hint of Russian spice.

ingredients.name: Oozing Cheese
ingredients.notes: Monterey Jack or Queso Fresco work well

instructions: 2. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
3. Add the bake ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
4. Add the Russian Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute.
5. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
6. Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of caramelized honey and a sprinkle of oozing cheese.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.
8. Serve immediately, with lime wedges on the side.
9. Cook for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted
